blocks.text: Halloween came early at the Miss Grand International 2026 as delegates showcasing mythological creatures during the national costume competition, with the Philippine bet Angelica Lopez wearing a sinister-loking “mangkukulam” (witch) outfit. Lopez gave the grand treatment to an otherwise scorned figure in Philippine folklore when she paraded in a massive 19-kilogram creation by designer Patrick Isorena during the pageant event held at the MGI Hall at Bravo BKK in Bangkok, Thailand, on Wednesday afternoon, Oct. 7. The show has been one of the most highly-anticipated events of the annual international competition, with the ladies pulling out all the stops to deliver […]...
